summary: A 1977 extension to FTP, called XSEN, that provides for sending a message to a logged-in user, with variants for mailing it normally. It adds new FTP commands with syntax like the existing MAIL command.

eli5.summary: Normally email waits in a mailbox. This extension lets a message pop up right on the screen of someone who is logged in.

questions: send message to logged in user ftp
